story.title: I Know
paragraphs_en: I go to school in the first month.
I open a book in the second month.
I learn to write in the third month.
I learn to count in the fourth month.
I learn addition in the fifth month.
I learn subtraction in the sixth month.
I learn to pack my school bag in the seventh month.
I learn to play sports in the eighth month.
I learn to read a book in the ninth month.
I learn to color in the tenth month.
I learn to draw in the eleventh month.
I am at the top of the class in the twelfth month.
